items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview

ctx.x: But people have talked about your playing that played with you. For instance, people like Blumenthal (PHONETIC) that write, writers, but then it's difficult to talk about critics like some people say the only good critics and bad critics -- they're naturally going to reflect their point of view and what they understand about music. But then someone like Billy Howell would come along, who is not a critic, who is an educator and musician himself, and talks
about how you use simple harmonies. Well, he sees it as a harmonic sense. You talked about percussion. But how about that?
